newsitem.title: USA: Jake's Pizza seeks additional financing.
newsitem.headline: Jake's Pizza seeks additional financing.

text.p: Jake's Pizza International Inc, which reported a narrowed loss for the fiscal third quarter, said it continues to search for additional financing to improve its liquidity.
Jake's Pizza said its liquidity problem is due to a shortfall of operating and paying franchises it needs to operate with a positive cash flow.

The company said it believes it will need approximately 65 healthy operating franchised restaurants to bring it to a breakeven cash flow. As of July 31, Jake's Pizza had 39 franchised restaurants, of which a significant portion cannot meet their obligations for various reasons, including cash flow restraints due to a weak franchise operation, it added.
These restaurants operate mainly in the Chicago area, but also in Arizona, Indiana, Missouri, and North Carolina.

Earlier, Jake's Pizza reported a loss for the third quarter ended June 30 of $176,418 or $0.14 a share before an extraordinary gain of $0.09 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $522,810 or $0.44.
Operating expenses declined in the quarter to $231,973 from $551,524.
